title: Is cold B2B email allowed
prompt: Is cold emailing procurement managers at SA companies OK under POPIA? It's B2B, so POPIA doesn't apply, right?
must: Corrects the premise: work emails of individuals are personal information and juristic persons are data subjects
Explains s69 applies to electronic direct marketing to non-customers and needs consent
Mentions the one-time Form 4 style consent request under s69(2)
Gives safer B2B routes (inbound, events with opt-in, non-electronic outreach)
must_not: Says POPIA does not apply to B2B
Says an opt-out link is sufficient consent
